release_rule: All stages must pass on one coherent action/carrier/readout chain before merge to main.

action_policy.reason: The saved 100-cycle rest pass and strongest short-time movement pass use different research actions.

stages.summary: Exact localized rest solution rebuilt on the clean branch with only standard Lean foundations.
The movement incumbent and four reciprocal timing variants all retain a Floquet multiplier outside the unit circle; the nonlinear 100-cycle gate was therefore not run.
Operational spin-half on the localized carrier.
Short-time Dirac transport and native current.
One complete cell crossing against the independent Dirac comparator.
Second unreset crossing in both directions.
Same-state mass, time, transport, density, current, and phase map.
Axes, diagonal, copies, perturbations, timestep, and box robustness.
Cumulative Lean theorem and clean release audit.
